SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") 
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."avgscrmath"::NUMERIC > 560
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s.phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr::numeric > 0
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500::numeric / sat.numtsttakr::numeric) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s."sname", s."avgscrwrite", sch."charternum"
FROM "satscores" s
JOIN "schools" sch ON s."cds" = sch."cdscode"
WHERE s."avgscrwrite" > 499
  AND sch."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
ORDER BY s.avgscrread::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT adm."admfname1", s."district", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT "admfname1", "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2", "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3", "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
) adm ON adm."district" = s."district"
GROUP BY adm."admfname1", s."district"
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s."school" = 'Youth Authority School'
  AND s."mailstreet" = 'PO Box 1040';

SELECT s."school", s."ncesschool"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.county = 'Fresno'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate::date) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude"::NUMERIC) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
SELECT s."school", s."street" FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds" WHERE sat."rtype" = 'S' ORDER BY sat."avgscrmath"::numeric DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s."phone", s."ext"
FROM "satscores" AS sat
JOIN "schools" AS s ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST
OFFSET 332
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.avgscrmath, sc.county
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
ORDER BY (s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."street", s."city", s."zip", s."state"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."numtsttakr" > 0
ORDER BY (sc."numge1500"::NUMERIC / sc."numtsttakr"::NUMERIC) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", AVG(sat."avgscrwrite") AS average_writing_score, s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE (s."opendate"::date > '1991-12-31' OR s."closeddate"::date < '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY s."school", s."phone";

SELECT
  f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS "free_rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Kacey%'
  AND s.admlname1 ILIKE '%Gibson%';

SELECT s."county", s."school", s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
  AND s."county" = (
    SELECT s2."county"
    FROM "schools" s2
    WHERE s2."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s2."county"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY s."closeddate" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '2000-01-01';

SELECT f."District Code", f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Alusine%';

SELECT s.city, s.school, f."Low Grade"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.latitude ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."admemail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", s."doctype"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN frpm f2 ON s2."cdscode" = f2."cdscode"
    WHERE s2."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s."admfname1", s."admlname1"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."numge1500" = (
    SELECT MAX("numge1500") FROM satscores
)
ORDER BY s."admfname1" ASC NULLS FIRST, s."admlname1" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.charter = 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18;

SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND s.gsoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY s.city ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."side" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."convertedmanacost"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'John Avon'
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards c
WHERE c."originaltype" = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND c."subtypes" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."subtypes" <> 'Angel';

SELECT "c"."id" AS card_id, COUNT(*) AS black_border_card_count
FROM "cards" AS "c"
WHERE "c"."bordercolor" = 'black'
GROUP BY "c"."id"
ORDER BY "c"."id" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
  AND c."promotypes" LIKE '%arenaleague%'
GROUP BY c."name"
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT fd."language", fd."flavortext", c."type"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c."uuid" = fd."uuid"
WHERE c."watermark" = 'colorpie';
SELECT c."keywords" FROM "cards" c WHERE c."name" = 'Angel of Mercy';
SELECT c."convertedmanacost" FROM "cards" c WHERE c."name" = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';
SELECT s."id" FROM "sets" s ORDER BY s."basesetsize"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'Aaron Miller'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c."originalreleasedate", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
  AND c."originalreleasedate" = (
    SELECT MIN(c2."originalreleasedate")
    FROM "cards" c2
    WHERE c2."rarity" = 'mythic'
  )
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT st.translation
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setcode = c.setcode
WHERE c.name = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
  AND st.language = 'French'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese' AND s."type" = 'expansion')::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON s."code" = st."setcode";

SELECT c."name", l."status"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."types" = 'Artifact'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
JOIN "rulings" r ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'premodern'
  AND r."text" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c."side" IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c."isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND c."istextless" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(c."id"), 0)::NUMERIC,
    2
  ) AS "percentage"
FROM "cards" c;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."code") 
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "set_translations" st ON st."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'
  AND (s."mtgocode" IS NULL OR s."mtgocode" = '');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'rare'
  AND c.types = 'Enchantment'
  AND c.name = 'Abundance'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT c.id, r.text, c.hascontentwarning
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniel%'
ORDER BY c.id ASC NULLS FIRST, r.text ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT s."name", s."mtgocode"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.id
FROM sets s
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
ORDER BY s.totalsetsize DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."name", r."text", CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = '1' THEN 'has missing or degraded properties and values' ELSE 'does not have missing or degraded properties and values' END AS "property_status" FROM "cards" c JOIN "rulings" r ON c."uuid" = r."uuid" WHERE c."artist" = 'Jim Pavelec';

SELECT c."name", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE s."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = '0' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c."id") AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'commander'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fd."language" = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fd."language" = 'French')::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*';

SELECT DISTINCT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "cards" c ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."isforeignonly" = 1
  AND s."isfoilonly" = 1
  AND fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE fd.language = 'French') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 0) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isstoryspotlight = 1;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT DISTINCT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."artist" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')
ORDER BY c."artist" ASC NULLS FIRST;
